target_customer: Small and medium businesses that sponsor a 401(k) plan
problem: 401(k) administration is confusing for small businesses, many still on paper. Online providers handle payroll but lack investment expertise, so firms add third party vendors that charge roughly 0.30 to 1 percent of assets.
business_model: Full service 401(k) for employers: $200 base plus $9 per eligible employee, with low fund and custody fees, run by an SEC registered adviser

founders.name: Rikin Shah
previous_startups: BigCalc (big data simulation startup for trading firms, outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Quantitative trading at UBS per the YC blog post of 2016-03-28. Met Malam at Imperial College.

founders.name: Dharmesh Malam
founders.background_notes: Worked on software at BlackRock and Fidelity per the YC blog. Not listed on the YC company page but named as co-founder in the YC blog post.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed portfolio management software, payroll integration and regulated recordkeeping, but the founders had finance software experience.

defensibility.rationale: An SEC registered adviser status and plan administration create switching costs and compliance work for rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. The company lists Vanguard only in an undated customer testimonial.

market_need_then: The YC post describes small business pain with paper 401(k) administration and high stacked fees. No dated 2012 demand data was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found only unrelated Octave companies and no press about this brand.

outcome_analysis: OctaveWealth came out of YC in 2012 but only reached private beta in late 2015 and a public YC launch post in March 2016, so it spent years in development. It is still listed as active with two people. No outside round, revenue or exit was verified, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: CB Insights lists a 120K seed from Y Combinator dated 2016-03-28; single aggregator figure, unverified, so no round recorded. The YC blog calls the batch Spring 2012 while the directory says Summer 2012. No competitor named in a source dated near 2012 was found, so the list is empty. Rikin Shah's role as CEO from the YC page; Malam named only in the blog post.
